seoTitle: Subject and Preheader Previewer: Mock Inbox Row
metaDescription: Preview how your sender name, subject and preheader are cut off in a mock Gmail, Outlook and iPhone inbox row. Free and private, runs in your browser.
intro: Enter a subject and a preheader to see them in mock inbox rows of different widths, with the cut-off shown by an ellipsis.
why:
Inbox clients show only part of your subject and preheader, and the part depends on the screen. A subject that reads well at 700 pixels can lose its key words at 340. This page shows the same text in three row widths so you see where it is cut.

The widths and fonts are approximations, not copies of the real clients, which also change with settings and updates. Use the preview to shorten and to move important words to the front. If you leave the preheader empty, clients usually show the first text in the email body instead.
howTo: Type the sender name, subject and preheader.
Look at the three rows and note where the text is cut.
Move the key words to the front and shorten the rest.
Check the character counts under the previews.
